CustomField.description: To determine the age of the activity
CustomField.formula: (5 * ( FLOOR( ( Today()- DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7 ) ) + MIN( 5, MOD( Today()- DATE( 1900, 1, 8), 7 ) ) ) - (5 * ( FLOOR( ( ActivityDate - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7 ) ) + MIN( 5, MOD( ActivityDate- DATE( 1900, 1, 8), 7 ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: It reflects the Age of the activity in working days
CustomField.label: Activity Age
